purpose: Ask whether ordinary reversible conformation switching, instead of frozen labels, can also account for concentration at a matched global B population.
selection_provenance: Registered after the first seed of the frozen explicit-fuel comparison, using the previous v01 passive df=0.2 composition as an independent anchor. Fresh seeds below are distinct from every prior cohort. No estimates from these seeds were read before registration.
design: At each seed run the parent and all three passive alternatives. Uniform reservoirs, fuel and waste particles, initial positions and conformations, diffusivities, and bond contacts match. Only df and the fuel-coupled path change in the reversible reference. The frozen controls have fixed conformations; these can change their conformation throughout.
observations: From the t=420..600 window record B population, width-4 variance and its x-only and transverse parts, chemical work, and gross/net reaction rates. Interpolate only between adjacent passive measured B knots at the same seed. Report both endpoints and residuals. Out-of-range active B is uncovered. Mobility and time-to-equilibration can differ even when the global composition agrees.
stops: Preserve all recorded outcomes and arrays. Finite time, finite volumes, idealized chemicals. This closes this run matrix; first-principles calibration and phase limits remain open.
